title: Support-guided OOD Removal with Diffusion
title_zh: 基于支持引导的扩散OOD移除

paragraphs.en: Many real-world signals are corrupted by localized, structured perturbations whose distribution is unknown: an intermittent background noise in a music recording, a watermark stamped on a photograph, a cast shadow. We study the task of recovering a clean signal x x from an observation y y containing such a localized out-of-distribution (OOD) corruption. We propose Support-guided OOD Removal with Diffusion, SORD \mathrm{SORD}{} , an iterative algorithm to recover x x using only two ingredients: a binary map of the corruption support and a single diffusion model pretrained on clean signals. SORD \mathrm{SORD}{} does not require any paired data or any statistical model of the corruption. We evaluate SORD \mathrm{SORD}{} on natural images and human faces with spatially localized corruptions including handwritten digits, other images, watermarks, and shadows, as well as audio recordings of different musical instruments with temporally localized corruptions including other instruments and human speech. SORD \mathrm{SORD}{} is competitive with, and often outperforms, posterior-sampling inpainting given the same diffusion prior and the same mask, source-separation baselines that require a separate diffusion model for each source, and, on several benchmarks, supervised networks trained on paired clean and corrupted signals. paragraphs.en: Localized corruptions arise in many restoration problems: a limited region of an image may be affected by structured noise, a watermark may cover part of an image, a cast shadow may alter a region, or an interfering sound may overlap a musical recording for a short time. These corruptions can be highly structured and semantically meaningful, rendering simple (e.g., Gaussian) noise models inadequate. At the same time, collecting paired examples or training a generative model for every possible corruption type can be impractical in the face of unexpected corruptions.
paragraphs.zh: 局部化损坏出现在许多复原问题中：图像的有限区域可能受到结构化噪声的影响，水印可能覆盖图像的一部分，投影阴影可能改变某个区域，或者干扰声可能在短时间内与音乐录音重叠。 这些损坏可能具有高度结构化且在语义上有意义，使得简单的（例如高斯）噪声模型不再适用。 与此同时，面对意想不到的损坏类型，为每一种可能的损坏收集成对样本或训练生成模型可能并不现实。

paragraphs.en: Existing approaches for removing localized corruptions generally fall into three categories. Supervised restoration methods learn a direct mapping from corrupted to clean signals ( Liu et al., 2021 ; Liang et al., 2021 ; Guo et al., 2023b ) ; these methods can perform well on specific tasks, but require paired clean and corrupted training data and are then restricted to removing corruptions similar to those seen during training. Posterior-sampling approaches combine a pretrained generative prior over clean signals with a known measurement model or likelihood ( Kawar et al., 2022 ; Chung et al., 2023 ) . While these methods have achieved strong performance on many inverse problems ( Lugmayr et al., 2022 ; Wang et al., 2023 ; Song et al., 2023 ) , including inpainting a masked region, they generally require the corruption statistics to be known ( Legin et al., 2023 ) , often assuming relatively simple likelihood models such as Gaussian or Poisson noise ( Chung et al., 2023 ) rather than corruptions with complex spatial, semantic, or temporal structure. Finally, source-separation approaches explicitly learn distributions for both the clean signal class and the corruption class, for example using separate generative models ( Stevens et al., 2025 ; Mariani et al., 2024 ) . These approaches can represent substantially richer corruption types, but require training data or learned generative priors for the anticipated corruption classes.
paragraphs.zh: 现有的去除局部损坏的方法通常分为三类。 有监督恢复方法学习从损坏信号到干净信号的直接映射（Liu et al., 2021; Liang et al., 2021; Guo et al., 2023b）；这些方法在特定任务上可以有良好表现，但需要成对的干净与损坏训练数据，因而只能去除与训练中所见相似的损坏。 后验采样方法将预训练的干净信号生成先验与已知的测量模型或似然相结合（Kawar et al., 2022; Chung et al., 2023）。 虽然这些方法在许多逆问题（Lugmayr et al., 2022; Wang et al., 2023; Song et al., 2023）上取得了出色表现，包括对被掩蔽区域的修复，但它们通常要求损坏的统计特性已知（Legin et al., 2023），往往假设相对简单的似然模型，如高斯噪声或泊松噪声（Chung et al., 2023），而非具有复杂空间、语义或时间结构的损坏。 最后，源分离方法显式地学习干净信号类别和损坏类别两者的分布，例如使用独立的生成模型（Stevens et al., 2025; Mariani et al., 2024）。 这些方法可以表示丰富得多的损坏类型，但需要针对预期损坏类别的训练数据或已学习的生成先验。

paragraphs.en: In many applications, these requirements can be restrictive or impractical. Paired clean and corrupted examples may be unavailable, and the corruption distribution may be too complex or unexpected to model accurately. We therefore consider a more weakly specified setting in which a strong generative prior is available for the clean signal class and the corruption is localized to a known support Ω \Omega ; we do not assume access to any paired corruption data, parametric corruption distribution, or generative model of the corruption class.
paragraphs.zh: 在许多应用中，这些要求可能过于严格或不切实际。 成对的干净样本与受损样本可能无法获得，且受损分布可能过于复杂或难以预料，无法准确建模。 因此，我们考虑一个约束更弱的设定：其中干净信号类别存在一个强生成先验，且受损仅局限于已知支撑集 Ω \Omega；我们不假设可以获得任何成对的受损数据、参数化的受损分布，或受损类别的生成模型。

sents.en: We therefore consider a more weakly specified setting in which a strong generative prior is available for the clean signal class and the corruption is localized to a known support Ω \Omega ; we do not assume access to any paired corruption data, parametric corruption distribution, or generative model of the corruption class.
sents.zh: 因此，我们考虑一个约束更弱的设定：其中干净信号类别存在一个强生成先验，且受损仅局限于已知支撑集 Ω \Omega；我们不假设可以获得任何成对的受损数据、参数化的受损分布，或受损类别的生成模型。

paragraphs.en: Our key idea is to replace statistical prior knowledge of the corruption distribution with structural prior knowledge of where or when the corruption occurs. In many applications, the corruption is localized: it affects only a spatial subset of an image, as with watermarks, shadows, or localized artifacts, or only a temporal segment of an audio signal, as when an interfering sound briefly overlaps with a recording. The corruption within this region may have complex and unknown structure, but identifying its support is often substantially easier than modeling its distribution. A broad class of anomaly-detection and segmentation methods have already been proposed to estimate the support of such localized corruptions ( Defard et al., 2021 ; Roth et al., 2022 ; Wyatt et al., 2022 ; Zhang et al., 2023 ; Kheirandish et al., 2026 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 我们的核心思想是用关于损坏发生位置或时间的结构先验知识，来替代关于损坏分布的统计先验知识。 在许多应用中，损坏是局部化的：它仅影响图像的一个空间子集，例如水印、阴影或局部伪影，或仅影响音频信号的一个时间段，例如干扰声与录音短暂重叠的情况。 该区域内的损坏可能具有复杂且未知的结构，但识别其支撑区域通常比建模其分布要容易得多。 目前已提出大量异常检测与分割方法来估计这类局部化损坏的支撑区域（Defard et al., 2021；Roth et al., 2022；Wyatt et al., 2022；Zhang et al., 2023；Kheirandish et al., 2026）。

paragraphs.en: Rather than attempting to model the corruption distribution, we treat localized corruptions as out-of-distribution (OOD) relative to a generative prior over clean signals. The observations outside the corrupted region Ω \Omega are regarded as clean and are preserved, while the region inside Ω \Omega is reconstructed using the clean-signal generative prior. Unlike standard inpainting, however, the corrupted observations inside Ω \Omega may still carry information about the underlying clean signal. Our algorithm, SORD \mathrm{SORD} , therefore alternates between explaining the observed corrupted region and reconstructing a signal that is consistent with both the learned clean-data distribution and the trusted observations outside Ω \Omega . At each iteration, SORD \mathrm{SORD} uses its estimated uncertainty to adapt its effective step size and evaluate an adaptive stopping criterion. Empirically, we find that knowledge of the clean-signal prior and corruption support alone can be sufficient to match or outperform approaches that rely on paired training data or explicit corruption models.
paragraphs.zh: 与其尝试对退化分布建模，我们将局部退化视为相对于干净信号生成先验的分布外（OOD）数据。 Ω \Omega 之外的观测被视为干净并予以保留，而 Ω \Omega 之内的区域则利用干净信号生成先验进行重建。 然而与标准图像修复不同，Ω \Omega 内的退化观测可能仍携带有关潜在干净信号的信息。 因此，我们的算法 SORD \mathrm{SORD} 在解释观测到的退化区域与重建信号之间交替进行，所重建的信号同时与学习到的干净数据分布以及 Ω \Omega 之外可信的观测保持一致。 在每次迭代中，SORD \mathrm{SORD} 利用其估计的不确定性来自适应地调整有效步长并评估自适应停止准则。 实验表明，仅依靠干净信号先验与退化区域的知识，就足以匹敌甚至超越依赖成对训练数据或显式退化模型的方法。

paragraphs.en: Figure 1 . For images, we consider both controlled additive corruptions to face images as well as specific applications in watermark removal and shadow removal in which the corruptions are not purely additive. For audio, we consider temporally localized additive audio interference in which a musical recording of one instrument is corrupted by another instrument or by human speech. Across these settings, we compare SORD \mathrm{SORD} with posterior-sampling (inpainting) methods using the same clean-signal prior and corruption support, supervised restoration models trained for specific corruption types, and multi-source diffusion models that explicitly model possible interfering sources. The results show that support information can substantially reduce the need for an explicit corruption model, while corruption-specific supervision remains advantageous when the test corruption is well represented by its training distribution. paragraphs.en: Diffusion models have been widely used as learned priors for inverse problems ( Song et al., 2023 ; Chung et al., 2023 ; Zhu et al., 2023 ; Zhang et al., 2025 ) , including inpainting a masked region ( Lugmayr et al., 2022 ; Kawar et al., 2022 ; Wang et al., 2023 ) . These methods typically assume a specified observation or measurement model together with a known or modeled noise distribution such as Gaussian noise, Poisson noise, and other non-Gaussian likelihoods ( Chung et al., 2023 ; Legin et al., 2023 ) . In contrast, localized structured corruptions need not follow a known parametric noise model or likelihood, motivating restoration under support information alone.

paragraphs.en: A broad family of methods focuses on source separation, treating a single observation as a mixture of multiple constituent sources and using learned generative priors to recover the individual components. For images, Stevens et al. (2025) model an observation as the combination of a clean image and structured noise, using separate diffusion priors for the signal and noise distributions and jointly inferring the two components. For audio, Multi-Source Diffusion Models (MSDM) ( Mariani et al., 2024 ) learns the joint distribution of a fixed set of musical sources, such as different instruments, and uses the resulting model for both generation and source separation. Related diffusion-based approaches learn source distributions for speech ( Scheibler et al., 2023 ) or separately trained priors for constituent communication signals ( Jayashankar et al., 2023 ) . These approaches rely on training data that represent the possible constituent source and corruption classes. In contrast, we assume a generative prior only for the desired clean signal; the localized corruption may come from an unknown class, may vary across observations, and need not be anticipated during training.

paragraphs.en: Localized anomaly and out-of-distribution (OOD) detection methods aim to identify spatial regions that deviate from the distribution of inlier data. A broad range of methods estimate such localized supports using feature-space deviations ( Defard et al., 2021 ; Roth et al., 2022 ; Liu et al., 2023 ) or learned anomaly representations ( Zavrtanik et al., 2021 ) . More recently, diffusion models have been used as expressive representations of the inlier distribution, enabling anomalies to be localized from discrepancies produced during denoising or reconstruction ( Wyatt et al., 2022 ; Zhang et al., 2023 ; He et al., 2024 ) . These works demonstrate that the support of an anomalous or out-of-distribution component can often be estimated without explicitly modeling its distribution; our work assumes access to this corruption support and uses it towards recovering the underlying clean signal.
paragraphs.zh: 局部异常与分布外（OOD）检测方法旨在识别偏离内点数据分布的空间区域。 大量方法利用特征空间偏差（Defard et al., 2021；Roth et al., 2022；Liu et al., 2023）或学习到的异常表示（Zavrtanik et al., 2021）来估计此类局部支撑区域。 更近期的做法是将扩散模型用作内点分布的富有表现力的表示，从而能够根据去噪或重建过程中产生的差异来定位异常（Wyatt et al., 2022；Zhang et al., 2023；He et al., 2024）。 这些工作表明，异常或分布外成分的支撑区域通常无需显式建模其分布即可估计；我们的工作假设可以获得这一损坏支撑区域，并利用它来恢复底层的干净信号。

paragraphs.en: We propose SORD \mathrm{SORD}{} , a diffusion-based method for removing localized structured corruptions without modeling their distribution. We assume access only to the support Ω \Omega identifying where or when the corruption occurs, and a diffusion prior pretrained on clean signals. A natural strategy under these assumptions is diffusion inpainting: discard the measurements inside Ω \Omega and generate the missing content conditioned on the uncorrupted observations outside Ω \Omega . However, such a strategy also discards potentially useful information. In our setting, the values inside Ω \Omega are not missing; rather, they contain a superposition of the clean signal and an unknown structured corruption. Our key insight is that these measurements can be progressively reused to improve an initial inpainting estimate.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出 SORD \mathrm{SORD}{}，一种基于扩散的方法，用于去除局部化结构化损坏而无需对其分布进行建模。 我们假设只能访问标示损坏发生位置或时间的支撑集 Ω \Omega，以及在干净信号上预训练的扩散先验。 在这些假设下，一个自然的策略是扩散修复：丢弃 Ω \Omega 内部的测量值，并以 Ω \Omega 之外未损坏的观测为条件生成缺失内容。 然而，这种策略也会丢弃潜在有用的信息。 在我们的设定中，Ω \Omega 内部的值并非缺失；相反，它们包含干净信号与未知结构化损坏的叠加。 我们的关键洞察是，这些测量值可以被逐步复用，以改进初始的修复估计。

paragraphs.en: SORD \mathrm{SORD}{} operationalizes this insight through three main components. First, we use diffusion inpainting as an initialization , and subsequently recover information from the measurements inside the corrupted region Ω \Omega through an alternating signal–corruption decomposition. Second, because the residual between the measurement and the current reconstruction can contain both corruption and incorrectly reconstructed clean content, we use variance across multiple diffusion samples to quantify uncertainty in the current reconstruction. This uncertainty determines the scale of the subsequent diffusion-based refinement. Third, we use the same uncertainty estimate to inform an adaptive stopping criterion. paragraphs.en: We compare against several DPS ( Chung et al., 2023 ) baselines using the same CelebA clean prior. DPS-Inpaint treats the corrupted support as missing and inpaints it by conditioning the sampling process on the observations outside Ω \Omega . We additionally evaluate DPS under a Gaussian likelihood assumption within Ω \Omega , either using the oracle corruption mean μ \mu or fixing μ = 0 \mu=0 , since in practice the corruption mean is inaccessible. The limited performance of these variants suggests that the evaluated Gaussian likelihood approximations are inadequate to remove highly structured localized corruptions. We also compare against SGM ( Stevens et al., 2025 ) , which uses separate diffusion models for the CelebA image distribution and each corruption distribution, as well as a variant of SGM which we endow with additional knowledge of the corruption support Ω \Omega . paragraphs.en: We introduced SORD \mathrm{SORD} for removing localized structured corruptions using only a pretrained clean-signal diffusion prior and knowledge of the corruption support, without requiring paired clean and corrupted training data or a separately learned model of the corruption distribution. Across image and audio tasks, this support-guided strategy consistently improves over simply discarding the corrupted measurements, as is common in inpainting, and achieves competitive performance against several specialized methods that use corruption-specific training data or priors.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 SORD \mathrm{SORD}，仅利用预训练的干净信号扩散先验以及对损坏区域的知识来去除局部化的结构化损坏，而无需成对的干净与损坏训练数据，也无需单独学习损坏分布的模型。 在图像与音频任务中，这种基于支持域引导的策略始终优于在图像修复中常见的直接丢弃损坏观测值的做法，并在与多种使用损坏特定训练数据或先验的专用方法的对比中取得了具有竞争力的性能。

sents.en: Across image and audio tasks, this support-guided strategy consistently improves over simply discarding the corrupted measurements, as is common in inpainting, and achieves competitive performance against several specialized methods that use corruption-specific training data or priors.
sents.zh: 在图像与音频任务中，这种基于支持域引导的策略始终优于在图像修复中常见的直接丢弃损坏观测值的做法，并在与多种使用损坏特定训练数据或先验的专用方法的对比中取得了具有竞争力的性能。

paragraphs.en: Our experiments also reveal limitations arising from the absence of a corruption-specific prior and the reliance on known corruption support. When the corruption class is known and well represented by training data, methods that explicitly model that class can retain an advantage; conversely, SORD \mathrm{SORD} is particularly useful when the corruption is unexpected or otherwise difficult to model. SORD \mathrm{SORD} also depends on a sufficiently accurate corruption support: overestimating the support tends to degrade performance gracefully, whereas leaving corrupted pixels outside the support can be substantially more harmful because those observations are treated as trustworthy. Future work may focus on jointly estimating the corruption support alongside corruption removal, developing more principled uncertainty-guided refinement and stopping criteria, and extending the framework to broader non-additive or partially specified corruption models.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的实验还揭示了由缺乏针对特定退化的先验以及依赖已知退化支撑集所带来的局限性。 当退化类别已知且在训练数据中有充分代表性时，显式建模该类别的方法可以保持优势；相反，SORD \mathrm{SORD} 在退化是意外的或难以建模的情况下尤为有用。 SORD \mathrm{SORD} 还依赖于足够准确的退化支撑集：高估支撑集会使性能平缓地下降，而将受损像素排除在支撑集之外则可能造成明显更大的危害，因为这些观测值会被视为可信。 未来的工作可以聚焦于在去除退化的同时联合估计退化支撑集、开发更有原则性的不确定性引导的细化与停止准则，以及将该框架扩展到更广泛的非加性或部分指定的退化模型。

paragraphs.en: The clean image priors are off-the-shelf ADM ( Dhariwal & Nichol, 2021 ) checkpoints for FFHQ and ImageNet-256 (for Imagenette). For CLWD, we use an EDM2 ( Karras et al., 2024 ) ImageNet-64 model fine-tuned only on the clean images from the CLWD training split. For SLBR, we train a domain-matched SLBR model from scratch on paired data from the corresponding training domain: paired FFHQ examples for FFHQ, and paired Imagenette examples for Imagenette. Training uses all of the CLWD train/test watermarks except for the 12 watermarks which we used for testing for FFHQ and Imagenette.
